title: Somewhere outdoors
prompt: a photograph of a place: a street, a building, a landscape, scenery

title: A room
prompt: a photograph of the inside of a building, a room, a hall

title: People close up
prompt: a close-up photograph of a person's face, a portrait, a selfie

title: People together
prompt: a photograph of a group of people posing together

title: A surface
prompt: a close-up photograph of a floor, a wall, a carpet or a plain surface

title: A reminder
prompt: a photograph taken as a reminder: a label, a parking space, a price tag, a serial number

title: Something broken
prompt: a photograph documenting damage: a scratch, a dent, a stain, a repair

title: An item
prompt: a plain photograph of a single object for sale, a product listing photo

title: A card or document
prompt: a photograph of an identity card, a driving licence, a passport, a ticket or a form

title: Something else
prompt: an ordinary photograph of something else

title: An everyday scene
prompt: an everyday scene with nothing remarkable in it
